SQLite 3.53.4 amalgamation, public domain.

Source: https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3530400.zip

Archive SHA-256: 1e71ddf93849c6a6ecf58b827c0692073d2dd7ee40196158068f7b29f422e87d

Official download-page SHA3-256: 628a44cfe82c66aed1ccbbe85a562d2e33ebe64b3288981ed76285612227934e

Only sqlite3.c and sqlite3.h are shipped. Statically linked; extension loading
disabled, double-quoted string literals disabled, default SQLite mutex support
retained. Build object is cached by build-sqlite.bat. No network access is needed
for subsequent builds. See https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html for provenance.
